title: Enfos Team Survival - SametC Edition V1.0.11
changenote: V1.0.11 - Easier opening and progressively harder 60-wave campaign, 60 distinct native wave/Boss models, special traits on every authored creep including invisible waves 11/21/49, synchronized invisibility and bounded native skill AI. Spellbringer reinforcements use wave+5 profiles/stats, with cursor area and accepted cast effects. Hero respawn scales from 30 to 50 seconds. Talent/account progression retired. Automated checks passed; engine gameplay and balance acceptance remain pending owner testing. Published at the owner's explicit request.
